summary: Verified cinematic Pin & Scrub + Cover Hero effect on IT SMARTCLOUT landing page at both 1920x1080 and 1440x900. All three phases (SCRUB, REVEAL/COVER, RELEASE) work as designed. Reverse scroll works cleanly. No regressions in navbar, cookie banner, or console.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx correctly derives scrubLen = hero.offsetHeight - innerHeight - revealPx (100vh), matching the CSS choreography (400vh scroller, sticky top:0 height:100vh, #values margin-top:-100vh z-index:2). Behavior is viewport-agnostic.
Video lerp smoothing (0.15) causes ~0.5-1s lag between currentTime and scroll target on fast scrolls, but converges within the 1.5s test wait. Not a bug — matches spec.

Minor: at scrubEnd, video.currentTime is ~6.58s on 1920x1080 and ~7.6s on 1440x900 (out of 8.04 duration) due to lerp; it fully catches up (~8.03) by mid-reveal phase. Acceptable given asymptotic approach spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measured metrics at 1920x1080: heroH=4320, innerH=1080, scrubEnd=2160, pinEnd=3240. valuesTop trajectory: y=0->3240, y=1080->2160, y=2160->1080 (viewport bottom), y=2430->810, y=2700->540, y=2970->270, y=3240->0. videoTime: 0 -> 2.99 -> 6.58 -> 7.57 -> 7.87 -> 8.01 -> 8.03. stickyTop stays 0 through pin range, then becomes negative on release (verified -113 at scrollY=3353, -737 at 3977). At 1440x900: heroH=3600, pinEnd=2700, all phases pass identically. Reverse scroll: values slides back down and video scrubs backward. No console errors, cookie banner present, 17 nav links.
